verdict.rationale: Fleet provisioning is a fair question for a hardware security key, but the evidence only covers single-user enrollment, reset, unpair, and removing a lost key. It shows no pre-registration, bulk configuration, or lifecycle tracking by the product itself. The probe says fleet management goes through the Google Workspace Admin console, a separate host-platform product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys
